speakingTasks.instructions: Read the following announcement aloud clearly. Prep 45 s / response 45 s.
speakingTasks.promptText: Welcome to the Eastbridge Community Library. Our study rooms are available from nine in the morning until seven in the evening on weekdays. Please reserve a room at the information desk before bringing in food or drinks. If you need to print a document, ask a staff member for a temporary printing card. We hope you enjoy your visit.
speakingTasks.anchorSample: Clear articulation of consonant clusters ("Eastbridge", "weekdays", "temporary printing card"), falling intonation at sentence endings, and natural pausing after prepositional phrases.

speakingTasks.instructions: Read the following announcement aloud clearly. Prep 45 s / response 45 s.
speakingTasks.promptText: Good afternoon, everyone. This is a reminder that the neighborhood clean-up will begin at eight thirty on Saturday. Volunteers should meet beside the main entrance to River Park. Gloves and reusable bags will be provided, but please bring a water bottle and wear comfortable shoes. In case of heavy rain, we will send an update by email before seven o'clock.
speakingTasks.anchorSample: Natural stress on content words ("eight thirty", "Saturday", "River Park", "reusable bags", "comfortable shoes") and smooth rhythm across compound clauses.

speakingTasks.instructions: Give your opinion, with clear reasons and a specific example. Prep 45 s / response 60 s.
speakingTasks.promptText: Should public libraries spend more of their budget on digital services than on printed books? Give reasons and an example.
speakingTasks.anchorSample: In my opinion, public libraries should allocate a larger share of their budget to digital services while maintaining a core print collection. First, e-books and online research databases allow working adults and remote students to access learning materials 24 hours a day. Second, digital subscriptions can serve multiple readers simultaneously without physical wear. For example, when my university library expanded its digital audiobook and journal portal last year, student borrowing increased by nearly forty percent.

writingTasks.instructions: Reply in an appropriate professional tone within 10 minutes. Write a helpful reply explaining the beginner equipment policy and the registration process; offer one useful additional tip.
writingTasks.promptText:
Email from: Community Center Registration
Hello, I would like to join the photography workshop this Saturday. Could you tell me whether beginners need to bring a camera and how I can register? Thank you. — Olivia Kent
writingTasks.anchorSample:
Dear Ms. Kent,

Thank you for your interest in our Saturday Beginner Photography workshop. Beginners do not need to bring a professional camera; the center provides loaner digital cameras, or you may use a smartphone. To register, please complete the online sign-up form on our community center website or visit the front desk by Friday evening. As an additional tip, please arrive 15 minutes early at Room A so you can sign out a loaner device before the session begins.

Best regards,
Eastbridge Community Center Team

writingTasks.instructions: Reply in an appropriate professional tone within 10 minutes. Reply politely, acknowledge the inconvenience, suggest a quiet room or booking procedure, and explain how to report facilities issues.
writingTasks.promptText:
Email from: Library Facilities Feedback
Dear Library Team, yesterday the study room was noisy, and I could not find a free power outlet. I would appreciate advice about quieter spaces. — Daniel Ross
writingTasks.anchorSample:
Dear Mr. Ross,

Thank you for contacting us, and please accept our sincere apologies for the noise and shortage of power outlets during your visit yesterday. For a quieter environment, we recommend reserving one of our individual silent study carrels on the third floor at the information desk or through our online booking portal; each carrel is equipped with two dedicated power outlets. In the future, if you notice noise or maintenance issues, you can report them immediately to the floor staff or submit a quick alert via the Facilities Help QR code on each study table.

Sincerely,
Eastbridge Library Facilities Team

writingTasks.instructions: Write an organized essay giving your opinion and supporting it with reasons and relevant examples. You have approximately 30 minutes. An effective response will normally develop its ideas fully rather than relying on a fixed word-count score.
writingTasks.promptText: Some communities are considering spending more public money on libraries instead of sports facilities. Which should receive priority, and why? Use specific reasons and examples.
writingTasks.anchorSample:
When municipal governments allocate limited public funds, both libraries and sports facilities contribute to community well-being. However, I believe public libraries should receive funding priority because they serve residents of all ages and socioeconomic backgrounds while supporting lifelong education and career mobility.

First, modern libraries provide essential educational and technological infrastructure that many households cannot afford independently. Beyond printed books, libraries offer free high-speed internet, study rooms, and job-search workshops. For example, in our district library, university students, remote workers, and senior citizens all rely on the computer lab every day to complete coursework and access government services.

Second, libraries operate year-round regardless of weather conditions and accommodate individuals with diverse physical abilities. While sports centers are valuable for physical fitness, parks and schoolyards can already support daily exercise at a lower cost.

In conclusion, prioritizing public libraries creates broader educational and economic benefits for the entire community.
